topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: Well, now, that’s a rare kettle of fish! To think that someone’s been spinning tales about me, like threads from the loom, weaving a tapestry of our lives. I can’t say I’ve ever pondered such a thing, my mind more often on the seeds and the rain, the turn of the seasons and the saint's days. But to have one’s own story, penned with care, woven through the pages—it’s a curious warmth, like the first light of dawn breaking over the fields. I reckon it’s a kind of harvest, one I never planted, yet here it is, ripe and ready. I should take it as a sign, a blessing from the saints, that my tale is worth telling.
